activity_additions.name: Divine charge crafting loop (energy → charge pack / machines / GOTE fuel)
activity_additions.location: Inventor's workbench discovery (Invention Guild / multi-city workbenches); weave is remote — no workbench required after discovery
requirements: 4 Invention to discover the Divine charge blueprint at an inventor's workbench

Divine energy by tier (wiki amounts): pale 2,000; flickering 1,000; bright 900; glowing 850; sparkling 800; gleaming 700; vibrant 650; lustrous 550; elder 500; brilliant 450; radiant 400; luminous 350; incandescent 225; ancestral 100
Normal Divination level for that energy tier is NOT required when weaving charges (e.g. incandescent usable without 95 Divination)
Optional late path: 101 Invention Divine-o-matic vacuum + empty divine charge blueprint (see kandarin:divine-o-matic-vacuum) — empty shells manufactured at workbench, filled while gathering
unlocks: Permanent craft recipe: weave divine energy + simple parts into divine charges (4 game ticks per charge; remote weave, no workbench)
Each divine charge adds 3,000 charge to the charge pack (augmented weapons/armour/tools/skilling tools)
Each divine charge also adds 3,000 machine charge to Invention Guild generators (machine AFK infrastructure)
Sustained fuel for Grace of the elves / signs of the porter drain (GOTE burns charge while porting gathered resources)
Without charges: perks inactive, most augmented gear falls to tier-1 stats, no item XP — charge-pack infrastructure alone is not enough without this craft loop
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-owns blueprint discovery geography (Invention Guild / inventor's workbench hub taxonomy) and the machine-charge consumer side.
Divine energy supply is multi-region Divination (wisp colonies, Guthixian Cache/Kandarin, Arc ancestral, etc.) — energy is optional pressure, not a second hard gate for the craft unlock itself.
Simple parts come from broad disassembly (logs/bars/flatpacks/etc.) — global Invention material, not a single elective region.
Divine-o-matic vacuum is already indexed as kandarin:divine-o-matic-vacuum (colony/Cache use-pressure); do not re-emit that id here.
activity_additions.notes: Closes wave-5 audit rank-8 gap. Distinct from asgarnia:charge-pack-infrastructure (pack capacity / drain reduction research) — this row is the consumable craft loop that refills pack + machines and powers GOTE. Do not invent GE prices or XP/hour. Ironman priority energy tiers for efficiency are wiki-table dependent (commonly luminous/incandescent/elder when self-gathered).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Energy colonies remain multi-region optional pressure. Pair with charge-pack research ranks and GOTE porter chain — do not score GOTE sustain without this craft loop. · Invention skill unlock and workbench manufacture are global (not Asgarnia-locked). Guild machine-room scenery stays Asgarnia place geography only.

activity_additions.name: Augmentor (permanent Invention manufacture unlock)
activity_additions.location: Inventor's workbench manufacture after blueprint discovery (Invention tutorial / Guild hub taxonomy)
requirements: 2 Invention (reached during Invention tutorial) to research/discover the Augmentor blueprint
Manufacture at an inventor's workbench from base / flexible / tensile parts + enhancing / powerful components + divine energy (any tier; energy amounts scale by tier)
Attachment level gates after manufacture: weapons at 2 Invention; body armour and shields at 16; tools at 22; leg armour at 45
unlocks: Permanent account ability to convert eligible equipment into augmented versions ready for gizmos
50 Invention XP on each successful augment application
Gates all charge-pack drain, perk sockets, and item-XP training on weapons/armour/tools — without augmentors there is no sustained Invention gear loop
Reversible via augmentation dissolver (destroys the augmentor; fully degrades degradable items)
region_pressure: Asgarnia owns Invention tutorial / Guild / workbench discovery taxonomy for the permanent blueprint.
Component and energy materials are global Invention/Divination supply — not elective-region gates for the unlock itself.
activity_additions.notes: High-value Invention production permanent missing from regional-skilling while charge-pack, gizmos, and machines were already indexed. Consumable per application but the blueprint discovery is the permanent account unlock. Complements asgarnia:divine-charge-crafting (fuel) and asgarnia:invention-gizmo-shells (perks).

activity_additions.name: Junk refiner (junk → refined components)
activity_additions.location: Inventor's workbench discovery/manufacture; refine is inventory device (usable remotely, including AFK side-activities)
requirements: 22 Invention to discover Junk refiner blueprint (usable below 22 at reduced yield: 9 refined components per device)
Manufacture materials: rune bar + crafted parts + junk (wiki creation recipe)
100 junk per refined component at 100:1 refine rate
unlocks: Permanent craft path converting Invention junk into refined components (critical material for many devices including divine-charge-adjacent and mid/late Invention recipes)
Components per exploded device scales with Invention level: 9 below 22 → 10 at 22–29 → … → 20 at 120+ (temporary boosts cannot exceed 20 components per refiner ceiling)
3 seconds (5 ticks) per junk set; 10 Invention XP per set refined
Check option shows remaining capacity before the device explodes
region_pressure: Asgarnia owns Invention workbench discovery taxonomy.
Junk supply is global from disassembly — not a region gate.
activity_additions.notes: High-value Invention production permanent. Complements auto-disassembler component farms without re-emitting machine ids. Refined components feed multiple device recipes; track as material sink pressure, not XP method.
